transcript.text: I cannot log in. The reset email never arrives.
Reset mail goes to the address on the account. Check spam, and confirm that address.
The address is mina@northwind.example. Spam is empty.
I can send a new reset to mina@northwind.example. The link lasts 30 minutes.
Please send that reset link.
Refund the charger. It died after one week.
I can start a refund once I have the order number from the receipt.
I deleted that email. Look it up.
I can search by the account email if you confirm it.
Just refund it. The charger is dead.
Someone in another country is placing orders on my card through this account.
Two orders from today do not match your usual city.
Lock the account. I did not place those orders.
I can freeze new orders. A specialist has to reverse the charges.
Get a person. This is fraud.
The app crashed when I opened invoices.
Update to version 4.2. That build fixes the invoice crash.
I updated. Invoices open now.
Good. The crash should stay fixed on 4.2.
Thanks, that is all.
Where is order NW-44198?
It left the warehouse yesterday and is with the carrier.
What is the tracking number?
The tracking number is 1Z999AA10123456784. Delivery is scheduled for Thursday.
Will Thursday delivery still hold if I am not home before 6 pm?
Export on the reports page does nothing. There is no error text.
I can give the workaround once I know the browser.
It is the June sales report. I need it today.
The workaround depends on the browser name and version.
Stop asking and send the file.
Your driver shouted at my employee and left the box in the rain. I am recording this.
I can file a complaint and replace the wet order.
I want a manager and the driver's name. My lawyer will get this recording.
I can replace the order today. I cannot give out the driver's name.
Escalate it. I am not discussing this with a bot.
Change the billing email to finance@cedar.example.
I will switch it after you confirm the current email on the account.
I am away from my desk. I will confirm the current email tomorrow morning.
I will leave the billing email unchanged until then.
Good. Do nothing until I write back.
How do I add a seat for a new teammate on the Pro plan?
Open Settings, then Team, then Invite. Enter their email. A Pro seat is $12 a month.
We are on Pro, billed yearly. Does the invite add a prorated seat?
Yes. An invite on a yearly Pro plan adds a prorated seat at $12 a month for the months left.
So I use Settings, Team, Invite, and the charge is prorated. Is that the whole step?
Cancel my subscription before the next bill.
I can cancel once I know which product. An account can have more than one.
The expensive one.
I need the product name. Price alone does not pick the row.
Cancel it now. I do not want another charge.
I found our company API key in a public paste. This account issued that key last month.
I can rotate a key only after a security specialist confirms the paste.
The paste is still up. Rotate the key now.
Rotation of a leaked key is a security case. I cannot complete it on this turn.
People can call our API with that key right now.
Is the status page showing an outage? My dashboard is blank.
Yes. The status page lists a dashboard outage that started at 14:10 UTC. No action is needed from you.
Should I retry, or wait?
Wait. Refreshing will not help until the status page clears the incident.
Okay. I will wait for the status page.
